protocol.hand_review: Protocol authored and spot-checked on ADV-0058 (stdout_head citations), ADV-0084 (Windows backslash path keys), AUD-0085 (fenced preview), and the planted fenced-mention fixture. No row was labelled by copying linter output.
protocol.independent_of_linter: Gold walks JSON by key name. The linter scans path-shaped tokens with a regex over use-blobs. They share a token alphabet but not a traversal.
protocol.mention: Path tokens inside ``` fenced regions, and unfenced tokens under documentary keys (question, example, original_preview, title, ...).
protocol.should_flag: gold USE token whose live stat on this worktree is absent
protocol.use: JSON values of keys named path/paths/*_path/*_file/*_schema, plus whole-value path strings, plus path tokens in stdout_head/stderr_head/raw_output/failure_reason/answer/basis.
